title: any rollback() that fails with missing greenlet will make asyncpg connection believe it's all done

labels.name: blocker
labels.description: issue that must be resolved asap as it is preventing things from working

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/11816

so with this, get to the input() then run in a console:

```
test=> SELECT state, query, datname FROM pg_stat_activity;
        state        |                        query                        | datname 
---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------+---------
                     | <insufficient privilege>                            | 
                     | <insufficient privilege>                            | 
 idle in transaction | select 1                                            | test
 active              | SELECT state, query, datname FROM pg_stat_activity; | test
                     | <insufficient privilege>                            | 
                     | <insufficient privilege>                            | 
                     | <insufficient privilege>                            | 
(7 rows)

```



```
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine
import asyncio


async def main():
    engine = create_async_engine("postgresql+asyncpg://scott:tiger@localhost/test", echo=True)

    conn = await engine.connect()
    await conn.exec_driver_sql("select 1")

    try:
        conn.sync_connection.connection.dbapi_connection.rollback()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"rollback wihtout await failed as expected: {e}")

    await conn.rollback()
    await conn.close()

    print(f"OK, pool is all closed up: {engine.sync_engine.pool.status()} "
          "but you have an idle transaction - go check! :)")
    input()

asyncio.run(main())



```

this is the patch:

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/asyncpg.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/asyncpg.py
index cb6b75154..3fcce2649 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/asyncpg.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/asyncpg.py
@@ -870,22 +870,20 @@ class AsyncAdapt_asyncpg_connection(AsyncAdapt_dbapi_connection):
             assert self._transaction is not None
             try:
                 await_(self._transaction.rollback())
-            except Exception as error:
-                self._handle_exception(error)
-            finally:
                 self._transaction = None
                 self._started = False
+            except Exception as error:
+                self._handle_exception(error)
 
     def commit(self):
         if self._started:
             assert self._transaction is not None
             try:
                 await_(self._transaction.commit())
-            except Exception as error:
-                self._handle_exception(error)
-            finally:
                 self._transaction = None
                 self._started = False
+            except Exception as error:
+                self._handle_exception(error)
 
     def close(self):
         self.rollback()

```
